data.name: Caramba!
data.detailed_description:
Yo-ho-ho! On this island was buried treasure chest, but that's bad luck - the captain forgot where exactly.
In this game, you have to train your memory and find the treasures of the captain.

  • Memory game
  • stylish cartoon graphics
  • author's soundtrack
  • multiple levels
  • Steam achievements
